about: Prompts to measure the assistant on videos it has never seen: what a turn costs (the usage line at its end) and what it makes. The dev briefs are for working on Tramme; the test briefs stay unseen while doing so and are only run to measure.

briefs.prompt: Make a 30 s launch video for Velo, a crypto trading app: orders filled in 10 ms, zero fees on stablecoin pairs, a live order book. Dark and electric, like the big exchange promos. End on velo.trade.

Announce our new feature: Notion-like AI summaries in Ledgerly, our accounting SaaS. Show a dashboard with an invoice list, the AI summary appearing, and the time saved (4 h a week). Clean, light, trustworthy.
Vertical teaser for Fernweh, a travel planning app, for TikTok and Reels: 3 cities, a shared itinerary, 'plan together'. Energetic, colourful, young.
Promo carrée pour le Sommet Data Afrique, 12-13 mars à Dakar : 40 intervenants, 3 scènes, 1500 participants. Inscriptions sur sommetdata.africa. Ton institutionnel mais moderne.
A short data story: solar power in Europe went from 3% of electricity in 2015 to 12% in 2024, it now beats coal, and costs fell 80% in ten years. Calm, editorial, like a newspaper explainer.

Launch film for Quill, a CLI that turns your git history into release notes. Show a terminal, the command, the generated notes, '2 minutes instead of 2 hours'. Developer audience, sharp, monospace accents.

Manifeste de marque pour Atelier Nuit, une marque de vêtements de sport éco-conçus : 'On court la nuit. On fabrique le jour.' Quatre phrases fortes, typographie massive, noir et blanc avec une touche de rouge.
Explain in 3 steps how Payd works: connect your bank, set a rule, get paid on time. Friendly explainer for small business owners, with simple icons.
Customer quote for social: 'Shipwise cut our delivery errors by 63%' — Amara Diallo, Head of Ops at Kora Foods. Make it look premium, with the number as the hero.
Story for Black Friday: Pixelforge Pro at -50% this week only, from 24€ to 12€ a month. Urgent, punchy, ends with a 'Get the deal' button.

Launch video for Halo, an AI meeting assistant: it joins your calls, writes the notes, sends the action items. Show the app's interface, a transcript turning into a summary, and 'Your meetings, done.'
Pub verticale pour Pulse, une app de running : ta course en direct, ton rythme, ton record battu. Dynamique, contrasté, vert fluo sur noir.
Annual results for Orabank Group: net income up 18%, 2.4 million customers, present in 12 countries. Corporate, reassuring, deep green and gold.
A text-only teaser for an indie game, Lanternfall, out on Steam on 4 November: mysterious, slow, glowing amber light in the dark, three short lines and the date.
Square ad for Kibo, a second-hand furniture marketplace: browse, chat, pick up the same day. Warm, friendly, show a product card and a chat bubble.
Product video for Sentinel, a cloud security platform: it scans 10,000 assets in minutes, ranks the real risks, and fixes them in one click. Serious, technical, dark blue with alert reds.
